reported_themes.one_line: Shift from direct-to-cell RAN software toward in-house RFIC (S->W band MMIC), 10-100+ GHz reflector/waveguide feeds, own BAW filter production yield, NGSO interference simulation.
One RF propagation framework calibrated across Wi-Fi + 5G NR + NTN with terrain/LiDAR inputs; 5G NR L2/L3 stack moved into the space-communications line.
Next-gen UWB SoC system-level validation (Dublin) + automotive-grade UWB/RTLS embedded stack (Barcelona).
Effort concentrated on the open-source SDK and reference-design layer rather than radio silicon.
OISL hardware moving from prototyping to volume manufacturing; customer-terminal modem validation ramping in Austin.
Delta on cross-technology-propagation-model: sustained US-based push on Wi-Fi standards software (802.11ax/11s) and full 5G stack development (gNB PHY, UE L2/L3).
Building a formal 3GPP standardization capability for direct-to-cell: RAN software development + validation + direct standards participation.
Deepening investment in the customer-side Starlink Wi-Fi router software stack (Wi-Fi software + hardware reliability).

Wi-Fi subsystem software tied to AR/VR link requirements across iPhone/Mac/Watch/TV; core Bluetooth software + protocols for current/next-gen products; cellular Layer-1 control software (RACH, SR, SRS, CSI, antenna selection) with pre-silicon verification.

6G prototyping testbed on OpenAirInterface (gNB L1 on CPUs/GPUs, DL digital beamforming, OSC xran + 7.2 fronthaul) in Taipei; 5G/6G modem digital IC design with AI-aided design in Hsinchu; 802.11 driver/firmware direction in Seoul with AI-assisted development.

Delta on starlink-mobile-ran-standardization: PHY/MAC algorithm work for Starlink Mobile in Sunnyvale (link adaptation, power control, timing advance, Doppler tracking, multi-beam scheduling, inter-beam interference analysis).
Delta: 5G NR/LTE RF front-end MCMs for Starlink Mobile (Irvine), S- to E-band GaAs/GaN MMICs (Redmond), Starlink wireless-stack PHY/MAC software with DSP (Palo Alto).

Hyderabad hardware group doing full-cycle RTL design (micro-architecture, RTL coding, timing constraints) of a Wi-Fi PHY signal-processing IP block for 'the upcoming Wi-Fi standard' (generation unnamed; by timing Wi-Fi 8 / 802.11bn).
Taipei Wi-Fi applications engineering supporting OEM/ODM design-ins on 802.11ax/be chipsets: RF front-end integration, EVM/ACLR/sensitivity characterisation, Wi-Fi/BT coexistence debugging.

Delta: silicon-photonics + electro-optical IC design folded into RFIC org (space and ground high-speed optical links); regulatory-compliance engineering extending to FCC/ISED/ETSI certification of consumer Wi-Fi routers and user terminals; antenna engineering reaching the Starship vehicle programme.
Delta: FPGA/digital-logic thread defining a new OISL digital system with few legacy constraints (micro-architecture, RTL, timing closure).

Systems team building test-automation frameworks (CI/CD, HIL integration testing, performance simulation/modelling) for the phased-array antennas linking satellites to customer terminals, factory and in-orbit.
ML (neural nets + RL) for cellular RF transmitter power control, calibration and DPD, landing in RFIC/system-firmware RF control infrastructure

System-level SAR / RF-exposure compliance validation: 1g/10g mass-averaged evaluation under head/body-worn/extremity conditions, tissue-equivalent liquids, cellular power-table definition and validation
Power-timeline and RF-performance benchmarking (scan/TX/RX/RvR) of shipping Wi-Fi/BT combo silicon to inform platform direction
Delta on leo-oisl-hardware: OISL laser-terminal optical/electronic components entering formal reliability qualification (FMEA/FTA, ALT/HALT, Weibull; Telcordia GR-468, MIL-HDBK-217 in scope)
Samsung Semiconductor (San Jose) building its own 802.11 MAC/PHY firmware stack and UWB chipset software, designed for coexistence with Bluetooth/UWB/cellular.

Aerospace communications engineering: end-to-end comms architecture across spacecraft, relay nodes, ground systems, cis-lunar/deep-space networks; TAO BLSR Space Communications group does the embedded platform software.
Finland R&I team: pre-standardisation research on 3GPP 5G-Advanced/6G radio resource management, link/system-level simulation.
AI/ML applied to 6G/5G modem system-test workflows and end-product feature validation, alongside 3GPP air-interface validation.

Meraki + common-hardware groups: AP firmware performance/data-plane optimisation, RF system design for next enterprise AP generation (UWB/BLE/GNSS alongside Wi-Fi), embedded software across AP/controller/cloud platforms.
Delta on leo-oisl-hardware/reliability: star-tracker flight software for OISL with autonomous fault recovery and AI/ML-driven decision-making.
GenAI/multi-agent (MCP/A2A) tooling inside System RF mining wireless manufacturing/design data across iPhone/Watch/iPad/Mac/Audio.
Test-automation frameworks incl. robotics-based systems validating next-gen Bluetooth connectivity (audio, gaming, fitness, location).
Delta: Reading (UK) thread for next-gen UWB transceiver analog/RF block design (Tx, PA, LNA, ADC, to 20 GHz, advanced CMOS).
Government/national-security constellation line: orbital mechanics, RF/optical link-budget and resource-scheduling modelling (El Segundo).
Delta on 6g-pre-standardization: 3GPP SA3 delegate driving 5G-Advanced/6G security standardisation.
802.11ac/ax/be radio firmware + LEO/Starlink backhaul + LTE/5G gateway in one IIoT product.
802.11 AP firmware/U-Boot bring-up on new hardware platforms with ML-team collaboration on adaptive networking (Bengaluru).

Enterprise Wi-Fi product software covering Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) and 802.11s mesh down to the hostapd/wpa_supplicant/mac80211 layer, plus 5G base-station PHY and L2/L3 protocol software - closer to shipping product than its earlier 6G pre-standardisation emphasis.
Deepening validation and test around an existing ultra-wideband product family rather than adding ranging algorithms - the shape of a line moving from feasible to high-volume.
New sub-area beside the established OISL and phased-array work: automated production test for user-terminal and on-board modem silicon.
Software investment in constellation-scale beam planning - which satellite points a beam where and when - a capacity-scheduling problem distinct from the RF/antenna hardware depth reported earlier.

Delta on the 6G pre-standardisation line (RRM 09-08, SA3 security 09-09): two new 3GPP working-group fronts opened the same day - RAN3 radio-access architecture (disaggregated RAN, RAN-to-core interfaces, cloud-native protocol evolution, AI-enabled RAN, slicing) in Finland, and CT1 core-network NAS protocol design for 6G in France.

Pulling the RF and semiconductor supply chain in-house: SOC/ASIC physical design and full-chip verification, silicon ingot growth and wafer production for Starlink solar cells, RF front-end modules for Starlink Mobile, and an in-house XBAW bulk-acoustic-wave RF filter line built on the Akoustis assets.

Security engineering for the constellation's ground and manufacturing side: a neuro-symbolic platform pairing LLM agents with a knowledge graph and real-time asset state store so automated conclusions stay auditable, defending manufacturing lines, launch sites and ground infrastructure; plus low-level embedded software for secure inter-subsystem satellite comms.

System-level interoperability validation for 5G NR (incl. FR2 mmWave) and emerging 6G / IMT-2030 pre-standard tech, with AI/ML anomaly detection and automated diagnosis, reproducing field issues with carriers and chipset partners.

On-device ML (Core AI) for wireless connectivity and voice-call features: cross-stack Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/cellular analytics module and telemetry probes for modem optimisation and anomaly detection, on-device and crowd-sourced learning, A/B validation.
In-house wireless SoC org (RF/analog through PHY/MAC and firmware) doing transistor-level layout of radio-transceiver blocks in FinFET at 16 nm and below.
New direction: testing satellite-to-ground communication against 3GPP — NTN and O-RAN conformance, LEO Doppler pre/post compensation (CFO/SFO), PHY/MAC and digital beamforming bring-up.
San Diego design of multi-chain mmWave RFICs with integrated PLLs — full Tx/Rx front ends from data converters to LNAs/PAs for beamforming systems, optimised for power and cost.
Nokia Space Networks building LTE/5G commercial RAN, cloud and core products for NTN with AST SpaceMobile - direct-to-mobile satellite.

Delta on leo-mmwave-rfic-design / leo-phased-array-antenna-test-automation: San Diego digital ASIC/SoC implementing the wireless system architecture in silicon (spec->RTL; 4G/5G/802.11ad/DVB-S2 background) + Redmond phased-array antenna calibration (calibration systems, FPGA/firmware/RF toolchain, VSA/VSG/VNA lab).

Delta on apple-in-house-wireless-soc-rf-layout / apple-5g-6g-interop-validation: full-stack programme management of the in-house cellular baseband (PHY, MAC/RLC/RRC, multi-SIM, concurrent RAT, architecture->production ramp) + carrier-configuration software for worldwide operator interoperability and field/IOT/type-approval debugging.

Delta: in-house cellular baseband effort now visibly spans RF silicon bring-up/calibration/validation (pre-silicon emulation to mass production), 5G/4G PHY firmware and AI/ML-assisted PHY-firmware verification; product-level test spans cellular/NTN/telephony; Wi-Fi PHY firmware bring-up for new wireless silicon appears in Herzliya, with RF integration/validation across San Diego, SF Bay Area, Los Angeles and Waltham.

New: Nokia's defence unit building tactical communication systems for defence/government customers (radio technologies, secure networking, cloud-native architectures, sensing) with dedicated over-the-air test environments for radio performance, coverage and mobility.

Delta: GNSS receiver design (RF, mixed-signal, RTL to firmware, ultra-low-power/high-robustness GNSS baseband) emerging as another vertically integrated wireless silicon line inside the same effort as the cellular baseband.

Delta: defence/government secure-communications stack now visibly extends to a network-management/OSS software layer (fault, configuration, operational awareness), cloud-native on Kubernetes, alongside radio and OTA test work.
Delta: satellite-to-ground 3GPP conformance pinned to Release 17 (RRC/NAS/NGAP/F1AP, Open RAN, VoNR/IMS) with Release 18 participation flagged as next.
